jobs.description:
# Commercial Project Manager

## About the Role

SunStrong Management is seeking a **Commercial Project Manager (PM)** to lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of **commercial and industrial (C&I) and utility-scale solar projects**. The portfolio includes re-powering initiatives, major remediation work, and **battery energy storage system (BESS)** installations.

This is a **remote** position responsible for managing multiple concurrent projects while ensuring safe, on-time, on-budget delivery that meets quality standards, contractual obligations, and customer expectations. The PM will collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, construction, O&M, safety, asset management, subcontractors, and landowners.

## Key Responsibilities

### Project Planning & Pre-Construction

* Develop project schedules, budgets, scopes of work, and risk assessments for C&I and utility-scale solar and BESS projects with Field Service Partners.

* Conduct site assessments, walkdowns, and constructability reviews for re-powering and remediation projects.

* Develop project execution plans, staffing plans, QA/QC plans, and safety plans.

* Coordinate design reviews and ensure engineering deliverables support project scope.

* Support procurement activities, supplier evaluations, and material forecasting.

### Project Execution & Delivery

* Oversee field work, subcontractor performance, and construction progress.

* Manage construction activities including module swaps, inverter refreshes, RSD retrofits, tracker repairs, BOS replacements, and BESS installations.

* Ensure compliance with **NEC, IEEE, UL, AHJ requirements, and utility rules**.

* Monitor project progress, production rates, and sequencing.

* Facilitate project meetings and resolve field issues, RFIs, and conflicts.

### Safety & Compliance

* Enforce site safety requirements and compliance with **OSHA, NFPA 70E**, and internal safety programs.

* Oversee JHAs, PEC/LOTO requirements, tailboard meetings, and incident reporting.

* Ensure subcontractors follow applicable safety standards.

### Contract & Financial Management

* Manage project budgets, cost reporting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.

* Oversee contracts, change orders, purchase orders, and vendor invoicing.

* Track scope deviations and negotiate change orders.

* Ensure projects meet margin targets and financial KPIs.

### Commissioning & Closeout

* Coordinate commissioning activities for solar and BESS systems.

* Manage QA/QC punch lists, inverter startups, EMS/SCADA integration, and utility witness testing.

* Ensure delivery of as-builts, manuals, reports, warranties, and training.

* Lead lessons-learned reviews.

## Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of C&I or utility-scale solar project management experience.**

* Strong understanding of **electrical systems, trackers, balance of system (BOS), and civil/structural work**.

* Proficiency with at least one of the following project management tools: **MS Project, P6, Procore, or Smartsheet**.

* Strong financial, communication, and leadership skills.

* Ability to travel as needed.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **engineering, construction management, renewable energy, or a related field**.

* Experience with **BESS deployments** is strongly preferred.

## Skills & Competencies

* Commercial and industrial solar project management

* Utility-scale solar project management

* BESS project delivery

* Project planning and scheduling

* Budgeting and financial management

* Risk assessment and project execution

* Construction management

* Electrical systems

* Trackers and BOS systems

* Civil and structural work

* QA/QC

* Safety and compliance

* Contract and change-order management

* Vendor and subcontractor management

* Commissioning and project closeout

* EMS/SCADA integration

* Communication

* Leadership

* Cross-functional collaboration

* Problem-solving

## Education & Experience

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, renewable energy, or a related field is **preferred**.

**Experience:**

* 3+ years of C&I or utility-scale solar project management experience.

* BESS deployment experience is strongly preferred.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

* **Work arrangement:** Remote

* **Employment type:** Not specified in the original job description.

* **Project scope:** Multiple concurrent C&I, utility-scale solar, re-powering, remediation, and BESS projects.

* **Travel:** Ability to travel as needed is required.

* No specific weekly hours or weekend requirements are stated.

## Compensation & Benefits

**Compensation:**

* Salary information is not provided in the original job description.

**Health & Wellness Benefits:**

* PPO and HDHP medical plans.

* Dental and vision buy-up plans.

* Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage.

* Employer-sponsored short-term and long-term disability.

* Voluntary life insurance.

* Legal services and multiple additional benefit options.

**Retirement:**

* 401(k) Safe Harbor Match of **100% of the first 4% and 50% of the next 2%**, with immediate vesting.

## Compliance / Additional Information

SunStrong Management is an independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in **residential and commercial solar energy portfolios**. Its services include operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company works with capital providers to support distributed renewable energy and manage clean energy assets at scale.

Responsibilities include overseeing an over-arching Integration project, working within the team to determine and communicate execution dates, status and generally keep the project and all meetings focused and on task. Preferred: Someone who has managed technical teams and understands System Administration, Networking support, Application upgrades,
Vendor management, GPO and Active Directory troubleshooting, Azure, O365 Email, and the End-user support experience. Someone who has Training experience.

Wealthspire is a dynamic and growing company. We are acquiring firms throughout the US, Canada, Ireland and the UK.
We are looking for someone with Project Management experience working with Technology Teams to assist us with our rigorous Office integration schedule. When a firm is acquired, they operate on their own Network and technology platforms. Our goal is to get the hardware, software, and technology infrastructure integrated with Wealthspire so that Wealthspire can become the Managed Service Provider. This position plays an essential part in the success of the Integration process. We need someone to understand how to work with Technology professionals and be able to speak their language. This role will occasionally travel to assist with large projects.

Review the Email migration process with new acquisitions and verify Employee rosters.
Work with the engineers to keep track of email migration tasks and identify risk.
Use Office Timeline and Power Apps to provide project status and reporting to customers.
Coordinate internal and client meetings, including agenda creation, meeting minutes management, and action item tracking.
Collaborate with project team members to support the Application Migration Project by participating in User Acceptance Testing, Quality Assurance Testing, and overseeing the management of Application Packaging workstreams.
Assist with tracking equipment deliveries.
Coordinate with the Facilities team in reviewing office construction timelines and coordinate move itineraries with engineers and firm contacts.
Act as a point of contact for Engineers to quickly mitigate project issues
Coordinate travel arrangements for Engineers and coordinate office move logistics with Site contacts.
Manage Email migration projects, which include updating project plans.
Conduct Email migration and Cloud training seminars via Teams Videoconference
Hold regular meetings with Engineers to decide progress and address challenges.
Aid with complicated project problem resolution. Catalog and track issues with RAID Logs, provide status updates to management, and ensure a solution is formulated.

This is a senior program management role responsible for driving complex, cross-functional software initiatives from planning through release.

The role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on operational rigor across dependencies, risks, governance, and delivery metrics.

You’ll also help shape PMO standards and improve how programs are managed across the wider organization.

A major focus is AI fluency, including designing reusable workflows that automate coordination, reporting, data analysis, and other high-frequency program activities.

You’ll serve as a senior voice and mentor within the PMO, helping other program and technical program managers adopt stronger practices and AI-enabled workflows.

Translate ambiguous and high-stakes cross-functional challenges into structured program plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, deliverables, and timelines.
Establish and evolve execution frameworks, including Agile/Scrum ceremonies, governance cadences, program artifacts, and operating practices.
Identify, monitor, communicate, and mitigate delivery risks while applying disciplined change management when scope, priorities, or timelines shift.
Provide clear, reliable, senior-leadership-ready reporting on program health, progress, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.
Contribute to PMO-wide governance by improving metrics, standardizing processes, and supporting adherence to established operating practices.
Design and deploy multi-step AI-powered workflows that automate recurring program-management activities across tools and data sources.
Build reusable prompt libraries, templates, automations, skills, and integrations for activities such as status reporting, metrics analysis, roadmap management, and Jira/Confluence data extraction.
Establish quality criteria and validation mechanisms for AI-enabled workflows and maintain accountability for the accuracy and reliability of automated outputs.
Share AI-enabled practices across the PMO and act as a resource for improving the team's overall AI fluency.
Mentor and coach program and technical program managers on execution practices, organizational priorities, and effective use of AI.
Maintain consistent program documentation, delivery metrics, status reporting, and operating cadences.
Help anticipate delivery challenges, improve organizational processes, and strengthen program-management practices across the broader organization.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
15+ years of total industry experience, including 8+ years of technical program management experience leading complex programs across multiple teams.
Deep understanding of software product development lifecycles and technical program management at scale, with a demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from concept through release.
Demonstrated AI fluency at a workflow-orchestration level, including designing and deploying multi-step AI workflows spanning multiple tools or data sources with measurable improvements in time or quality.
Hands-on experience automating program-management workflows using AI, scripting, or related technologies, including extracting and analyzing data from tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Experience creating reusable prompts, workflow templates, skills, connectors, or plugins that can be adopted by other program and technical program managers.
Strong judgment around AI-assisted work, including defining quality criteria, validating outputs, and maintaining accountability for automated results.
Experience with project-management platforms such as Atlassian tools, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent, along with strong Agile/Scrum knowledge and familiarity with SAFe.
Experience collaborating with product management, design and UX, customer success, customer support, sales, marketing, legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience with program and project governance, including budgeting, vendor management, compliance, metrics, and reporting.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management, mentoring, and leadership skills across distributed teams and multiple time zones.
Self-directed and adaptable, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and maintain execution discipline.
PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or similar professional credentials are a plus.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Program Manager based in United States.

This is a senior program management role responsible for driving complex, cross-functional software initiatives from planning through release.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, design, QA, platform, and operations leaders to turn ambiguous challenges into clear execution plans.

The role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on operational rigor across dependencies, risks, governance, and delivery metrics.

You’ll also help shape PMO standards and improve how programs are managed across the wider organization.

A major focus is AI fluency, including designing reusable workflows that automate coordination, reporting, data analysis, and other high-frequency program activities.

You’ll serve as a senior voice and mentor within the PMO, helping other program and technical program managers adopt stronger practices and AI-enabled workflows.

The environment is fast-moving, collaborative, distributed, and designed for people who thrive on ownership, high standards, and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities

Own program management for complex, multi-team software initiatives, coordinating execution across engineering, product, design, QA, platform, and operations throughout the software development lifecycle.
Translate ambiguous and high-stakes cross-functional challenges into structured program plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, deliverables, and timelines.
Establish and evolve execution frameworks, including Agile/Scrum ceremonies, governance cadences, program artifacts, and operating practices.
Identify, monitor, communicate, and mitigate delivery risks while applying disciplined change management when scope, priorities, or timelines shift.
Provide clear, reliable, senior-leadership-ready reporting on program health, progress, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.
Contribute to PMO-wide governance by improving metrics, standardizing processes, and supporting adherence to established operating practices.
Design and deploy multi-step AI-powered workflows that automate recurring program-management activities across tools and data sources.
Build reusable prompt libraries, templates, automations, skills, and integrations for activities such as status reporting, metrics analysis, roadmap management, and Jira/Confluence data extraction.
Establish quality criteria and validation mechanisms for AI-enabled workflows and maintain accountability for the accuracy and reliability of automated outputs.
Share AI-enabled practices across the PMO and act as a resource for improving the team's overall AI fluency.
Mentor and coach program and technical program managers on execution practices, organizational priorities, and effective use of AI.
Maintain consistent program documentation, delivery metrics, status reporting, and operating cadences.
Help anticipate delivery challenges, improve organizational processes, and strengthen program-management practices across the broader organization.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
15+ years of total industry experience, including 8+ years of technical program management experience leading complex programs across multiple teams.
Deep understanding of software product development lifecycles and technical program management at scale, with a demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from concept through release.
Demonstrated AI fluency at a workflow-orchestration level, including designing and deploying multi-step AI workflows spanning multiple tools or data sources with measurable improvements in time or quality.
Hands-on experience automating program-management workflows using AI, scripting, or related technologies, including extracting and analyzing data from tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Experience creating reusable prompts, workflow templates, skills, connectors, or plugins that can be adopted by other program and technical program managers.
Strong judgment around AI-assisted work, including defining quality criteria, validating outputs, and maintaining accountability for automated results.
Experience with project-management platforms such as Atlassian tools, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent, along with strong Agile/Scrum knowledge and familiarity with SAFe.
Experience collaborating with product management, design and UX, customer success, customer support, sales, marketing, legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience with program and project governance, including budgeting, vendor management, compliance, metrics, and reporting.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management, mentoring, and leadership skills across distributed teams and multiple time zones.
Self-directed and adaptable, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and maintain execution discipline.
PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or similar professional credentials are a plus.
Experience with fintech platforms, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, or other cloud technologies is a plus.

Equity opportunity as part of the overall compensation package.
Health, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Shopify)
jobs.description:
About Drive Digital

Drive Digital is a Brisbane-based Shopify eCommerce agency specialising in designing, building and optimising high-performing online stores. We partner with brands of all sizes to create digital experiences that help merchants grow, scale and convert. Our team blends UX/UI design, custom development, platform migrations, integrations and performance optimisation to deliver tailored Shopify solutions that power business success.

Why this role matters

The merchants we work with are running complex Shopify Plus environments with multi-store setups, B2B, headless front ends, ERP and 3PL integrations, and subscription or loyalty stacks. They are asking us to tell them what to build and why, not just to manage the build.
We need someone who can sit in front of a senior client, understand their commercial position, shape the solution with our senior team, scope it properly, build the parts that do not need a developer, and hold the technical quality of everything we ship. You are the person our developers come to when a requirement is ambiguous and our clients come to when a solution is required. 

What you’ll do

Solution design and architecture

Contribute to the solution design for complex Shopify Plus builds, migrations and integrations, working with our senior team rather than in isolation
Bring client and commercial context into architectural decisions on multi-store, B2B, headless and API-driven work, and document what is agreed so the team can execute against it
Interrogate third-party apps and middleware properly rather than taking vendor claims at face value
Own technical feasibility on the work you scope

Hands-on implementation

Configure and deliver the no-code parts of a solution end to end yourself: Shopify Admin configuration, app setup and integration, metafields and metaobjects, theme and template settings, discounts, Markets, B2B and checkout configuration
Take those pieces from requirement to live without handing them to a developer
Own data migration and remapping on replatforming and integration projects: audit and clean source data, map products, variants, collections, customers, orders and content into Shopify's structure, and run the imports and validation yourself
Brief and coordinate the development team on the custom pieces, and hold the standard of what comes back
Understand the whole solution as one thing, including how your configuration and their code depend on each other, and be accountable for it working

Technical scoping

Write the functional and technical specifications our developers build from
Break complex requirements into estimable work, challenge unrealistic estimates in both directions, and hold the line on scope once it is agreed
Identify the upstream risk in a brief before it becomes a budget overrun or a rebuild

Project delivery and management

Own end-to-end delivery of your projects: scope, schedule, budget, resourcing and outcome
Plan and sequence work across design, development and QA, and manage the dependencies between your own configuration work and the custom development around it
Run the day to day properly: task and sprint management in ClickUp, time and budget tracking in Harvest, clear status reporting to clients and internally
Manage change requests and scope creep, raising variations early rather than absorbing them into the budget
Identify and escalate risk before it affects timeline, cost or quality
Review developer output and coordinate QA and UAT against the specification, not just against the ticket
Own the release process through to go-live and post-launch support
Mentor project managers on technical scoping, estimation and delivery discipline

Client advisory

Act as a senior technical contact on key accounts, working alongside the Director and Head of Delivery
Contribute to ecommerce and platform strategy for key accounts: where the store should go next, what will move conversion and retention, and what is not worth building
Help shape Shopify roadmaps that connect to the client's commercial goals rather than a backlog of requests
Bring an informed point of view on replatforming, expansion and consolidation decisions
Translate commercial objectives into platform decisions, and platform constraints into language clients can act on
Surface opportunities worth pursuing, and say clearly when a client's priority order is working against their own goals
Hold clear conversations about cost, trade-offs and timing, and be believed when you do

Senior stakeholder management

Manage multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities, internally and client-side
Represent Drive Digital's technical position to clients, partners and vendors

Who you are

Minimum five years hands-on Shopify experience (required).
Agency-side or in a senior in-house ecommerce role, on complex builds rather than a volume of small projects
Substantial Shopify Plus experience in a technical capacity
: configuring the platform yourself, scoping integrations, specifying custom development and contributing to architectural decisions
You implement, not just direct.
You configure and deliver the no-code and low-code parts of a solution yourself, end to end, and you are comfortable being measured on that output
You hold the whole picture.
You can carry a full solution in your head across configuration, custom development, integrations and data, and see where the pieces will not meet before they are built
Technically fluent enough to hold a developer to account.
You can read Liquid, work with Shopify's Admin and Storefront APIs, understand webhooks, metafields and metaobjects, and reason about data flow between Shopify and external systems. You do not need to ship production code, but you need to know when a developer's approach is wrong and be able to say why
Solution design experience.
You have shaped Shopify Plus solutions end to end, working alongside other senior people, and owned the outcome including the parts that went wrong
Senior client credibility.
You have advised at executive or founder level on decisions with real commercial consequence, and held your position under pressure
Commercial judgement.
You understand agency economics, scope risk and where margin is won or lost, and you price and scope accordingly
Direct and clear.
You raise problems early, you do not soften bad news into ambiguity, and you write specifications people can actually build from

Extra points if you have

Hands-on development background, current or former, in Liquid, JavaScript or a headless framework such as Hydrogen or Next.js
Experience with Shopify Plus B2B, Shopify POS, Markets, Functions, checkout extensibility or multi-store architecture
Depth in the app and integration ecosystem: subscriptions, ERP and 3PL connections, PIM, loyalty, search and merchandising, middleware such as Celigo or Alloy
Platform migration experience, particularly from Magento, BigCommerce or bespoke builds

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the implementation and rollout
of a new payment processing solution across our SaaS platform.
This is a highly cross-functional initiative spanning Product, Engineering, DevOps, QA,
Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and external payment partners. The Senior Project
Manager will own the end-to-end program plan, coordinate execution across teams in Los
Angeles and Bangalore, India, manage dependencies and risks, and drive the program
through implementation, testing, migration, and production rollout.
The ideal candidate is a strong technical project leader who is comfortable operating in a
fast-paced SaaS environment, can create structure across complex workstreams, and knows
how to drive teams toward clear commitments and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

● Own the end-to-end implementation plan for the new payment processor, from
planning and requirements through development, testing, migration, launch, and
post-launch stabilization.
● Translate program objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, dependencies,
owners, and delivery dates.
● Establish and maintain the integrated project plan and critical path across Product,
Engineering, QA, Finance, and external partners.
● Drive accountability for commitments and proactively identify when milestones or
deliverables are at risk.
● Ensure requirements, decisions, dependencies, and action items are clearly documented
and understood across teams.

Cross-Functional & Global Coordination

● Coordinate execution across teams located in Los Angeles and Bangalore, creating an
effective operating cadence across time zones.
● Establish clear handoffs between U.S. and India-based teams to maintain momentum
and minimize delays.
● Facilitate working sessions, project reviews, risk reviews, and executive status updates.
● Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure technical work
remains aligned with business and customer requirements.
● Coordinate with the payment processor and other external vendors or partners as
required.

Risk, Dependency & Issue Management

● Maintain a clear view of program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
● Identify blockers early and drive them to resolution rather than simply reporting them.
● Escalate issues with clear context, impact, options, and recommended next steps.
● Track dependencies across APIs, platform services, payment workflows, data, security,
finance, reporting, and customer-facing experiences.
● Ensure critical decisions are made at the appropriate level and documented.

Testing, Migration & Launch Readiness

● Coordinate integrated testing across Engineering, DevOps, QA, Product, Finance, Sales,
Customer Success and business stakeholders.
● Drive readiness for functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, UAT, and
production validation.
● Develop and manage a comprehensive cutover and go-live plan, including
dependencies, owners, rollback/contingency plans, and success criteria.
● Coordinate customer or transaction migration planning where applicable.
● Establish launch-readiness criteria and ensure outstanding issues are appropriately
triaged before go-live.
● Lead post-launch stabilization tracking and ensure issues are resolved quickly.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication

● Provide concise, transparent reporting on overall status, milestones, risks,
dependencies, decisions, and upcoming priorities.
● Tailor communication appropriately for technical teams, business stakeholders,
executives, and external partners.
● Surface risks early without creating unnecessary noise or escalation.
● Create clarity when teams have competing priorities or conflicting perspectives.

Required Experience & Skills

● 7+ years of project/program management experience, preferably within SaaS,
fintech, payments, or other complex technology environments.
● Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional technology
implementations from planning through production launch.
● Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including requirements,
development, QA, UAT, release management, and production stabilization.
● Experience coordinating distributed or global engineering teams; experience working
with U.S. and India-based teams strongly preferred.
● Strong project planning skills with the ability to manage complex dependencies and
critical paths.
● Experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, QA, Finance,
Operations, and executive stakeholders.
● Strong risk and issue management capabilities.
● Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar project/program

management platforms.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
● Ability to operate effectively in an environment where requirements and priorities may
evolve.

Preferred Experience

● Experience implementing or migrating payment processors, payment gateways, or
payment platforms.
● Understanding of payment concepts such as authorization, capture, settlement, refunds,
chargebacks, recurring payments, tokenization, and reconciliation.
● Familiarity with PCI DSS, payment security, data privacy, and compliance
considerations.
● Experience with payment APIs, third-party integrations, webhooks, transaction flows,
and SaaS platform architecture.
● Experience coordinating payment processor certification, testing, or production
readiness.
● Experience with phased migrations or transitioning customers/transactions from one
payment platform to another.

What Success Looks Like

The Senior Project Manager will create a single, trusted view of the payment
implementation, with clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
Teams across Los Angeles and Bangalore will understand what they own, when it is due, what
they depend on, and what could put the launch at risk.

Most importantly, the new payment processor will move into production through a
well-managed, thoroughly tested, and controlled rollout with clear launch criteria, contingency planning, and post-launch support.

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of complex Salesforce transformation initiatives that solve real-world business challenges and deliver measurable client value. This role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable plans, aligning cross-functional teams, and ensuring projects are delivered within scope, on schedule, and within budget.

As a trusted client advisor and people leader, the Salesforce Project Manager oversees internal and client teams, manages project risks and financial performance, and promotes delivery excellence through Agile practices, effective governance, and continuous improvement. The Manager also contributes to team development, business growth, and the advancement of project management capabilities across the organization.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 5 years of experience managing technology implementation or digital transformation projects, including responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, risks, resources, and client outcomes.
Minimum of 3 years of experience leading Salesforce implementation projects or programs.
Demonstrated experience delivering multiple complex, enterprise-level projects from initiation through completion.
Experience leading cross-functional teams that include business analysts, architects, developers, quality assurance professionals, designers, and client stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate project risks and delivery dependencies.
Experience presenting project status, recommendations, and escalations to executive and C-level stakeholders.
Experience coaching, mentoring, or managing project team members.
Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, negotiation, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Ability to travel as required based on client and project needs.
Current professional certifications in both of the following areas: Project management or Agile delivery, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Agilist, or an equivalent certification; such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Business Analyst, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or another relevant Salesforce certification.

Preferred Qualifications

7 or more years of experience leading enterprise technology implementations, with significant experience in consulting or professional services.
Experience managing large-scale or multi-workstream Salesforce transformation programs.
Advanced Salesforce certifications or multiple certifications across Salesforce clouds and platform capabilities.
Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Data Cloud, or industry-specific Salesforce solutions.

Experience managing third-party vendors, subcontractors, and technology partners.

Experience supporting proposals, statements of work, project estimation, resource planning, and other business-development activities.
Demonstrated success developing project management talent and contributing to recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and performance management.
Ability to identify opportunities for account growth and build trusted, long-term client relationships.
Track record of improving delivery processes, sharing leading practices, and contributing to organizational knowledge and thought leadership.

jobs.title: Region Security Manager - APAC
jobs.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow.

As our Region Security Manager - APAC, you'll play a vital role in protecting our people, operations, assets and reputation across one of the world's most diverse and dynamic regions.

Working as part of our Global Security & Resilience team, you'll provide leadership across security, resilience, crisis response, intelligence and business continuity, helping ensure Jacobs remains prepared, protected and resilient in an increasingly complex risk environment.

This is a unique opportunity to influence security strategy across Asia Pacific while partnering with leaders across the business and a globally connected team of security professionals.

As the Region Security Manager for APAC, you will

Act as a trusted advisor on security and resilience matters across the region.
Lead security programs designed to protect our people, operations and assets.
Monitor emerging threats, risk trends and geopolitical developments impacting our business.
Support emergency response, crisis management and business continuity activities.
Partner with business leaders to strengthen security awareness and capability.
Manage physical security programs and support the implementation of security technologies and systems.
Build strong relationships with external agencies, government bodies and law enforcement organisations where appropriate.
Contribute to investigations relating to security incidents and corporate policy matters.
Support regional travel security and workforce protection programs.
Collaborate with colleagues across our global security network to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Here's what you'll need

We are keen to connect with experienced security professionals who combine strong operational expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels. You may have built your career within defence or military environments, government agencies, law enforcement, corporate security, critical infrastructure, emergency management, crisis and resilience functions, or security consulting. Regardless of your background, you will bring a proactive approach to managing complex security challenges, delivering practical solutions, and supporting organisational objectives in a dynamic environment.

Experience in areas such as the following would be highly regarded

Enterprise security management
Physical security design and implementation
Crisis and emergency management
Business continuity and resilience
Intelligence analysis and threat assessment
Security investigations
Travel risk management
Mass communication and emergency notification platforms
Security governance and compliance frameworks
ISO standards and security best practice

You'll have significant autonomy to shape outcomes across the APAC region, working with a diverse range of stakeholders, cultures and operating environments. You'll be part of a close-knit global team where trust, collaboration and expertise matter. While the team is geographically dispersed, there is a strong sense of connection and shared purpose.

Given the nature of the role, there will be occasions where incident response, crisis management or emergency situations require support outside of traditional business hours. Flexibility is important.

In return, Jacobs is committed to providing flexibility that works both ways. Whether you need flexibility for school drop-offs, family responsibilities, caring commitments or simply managing your work-life balance differently, we're committed to supporting arrangements that enable our people to thrive both professionally and personally.

If you're excited about this opportunity but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. You may bring transferable skills, leadership experience, operational expertise or unique perspectives that could make you an outstanding addition to our team.

You'll work alongside experts who are passionate about making a positive difference while helping create a safer, more resilient future for our colleagues, clients and communities.

Apply Today And Help Us Protect What Matters Most.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs here.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of diverse perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Our meticulously curated employee benefits support ALL employees throughout every stage of life. From paid parental leave to a lifetime financial allowance for you and your partner to access family forming Fertility & IVF treatment, adoption and surrogacy assistance along with menopause and Low T treatment.

We are steadfast in our commitment to the wellbeing of you and your loved ones with a comprehensive suite of wellbeing resources supporting you physically, emotionally and financially. This is demonstrated in our company being recognised by WGEA for 12 consecutive years as an employer of choice for gender equality along with our industry leading GOLD employer status by the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

Cultural Support

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are strongly encouraged to apply. Jacobs aims to provide cultural safety at our interviews. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are invited to nominate a cultural representative to participate on the interview panel; please let your recruiter know in your application. No matter what drives you, you'll discover a way to cultivate, nurture and achieve your goals – all at a single global company.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Position Overview The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, monitoring, and delivering projects from initiation through completion. The role ensures projects are delivered according to approved scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, contractual requirements, and business objectives.
The Project Manager serves as the central point of coordination between internal teams, clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, vendors, and senior management. The position oversees project plans, schedules, resources, costs, risks, issues, changes, quality, documentation, and stakeholder communication while ensuring effective decision-making and timely project delivery.
Key Responsibilities Lead projects from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, completion, handover, and post-project review.
Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, success criteria, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and key performance indicators.
Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans covering activities, schedules, resources, budgets, procurement, risks, quality requirements, and deliverables.
Establish project milestones and monitor progress against approved schedules, deadlines, budgets, and performance targets.
Coordinate internal departments, project teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers, vendors, and third-party service providers involved in project delivery.
Assign responsibilities, coordinate workloads, monitor team performance, and ensure project activities are completed according to agreed requirements.
Ensure appropriate manpower, materials, equipment, technology, and other resources are available throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress using schedules, dashboards, project-management systems, progress reports, and performance-tracking tools.
Identify delays, dependencies, resource constraints, technical issues, and other obstacles and implement appropriate corrective and recovery actions.
Manage project scope and ensure deliverables remain aligned with approved objectives, specifications, and stakeholder requirements.
Control project changes, variations, change requests, and scope deviations while assessing their impact on cost, schedule, resources, quality, and delivery.
Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Maintain risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, decision registers, change records, and other project-control documentation.
Escalate significant risks, issues, delays, cost concerns, and project decisions to senior management or relevant stakeholders when required.
Develop, monitor, and control project budgets, forecasts, expenditures, commitments, and overall cost performance.
Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, Commercial, and relevant departments regarding project costs, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, claims, and financial documentation.
Support procurement activities including supplier selection, quotations, contracts, materials, equipment, services, and delivery requirements.
Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and vendor performance against contractual obligations, schedules, quality standards, and agreed deliverables.
Review project documentation, technical submissions, drawings, specifications, schedules, reports, and other deliverables where applicable.
Ensure project activities comply with approved specifications, quality requirements, company policies, contractual obligations, safety standards, and applicable regulations.
Establish and monitor quality-control processes to ensure project deliverables meet required standards and stakeholder expectations.
Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, implementation, acceptance, handover, and close-out activities where applicable.

jobs.description:
Organization

Humanitarian Logistics Cooperative (Hulo)

Posted 17 Sep 2026 Closing date 31 Oct 2026

Title:
Project Manager: HLGSC Procurement TWG (Global Humanitarian Procurement Collaboration and Performance Initiative)

Date:
As soon as possible

Concerned Project(s):
Global Procurement Forum

ToR Reference Number:
HULO-HQ-PROC-2026-001

This Call for Interest is open to all eligible consultants, in accordance with hulo’s procedures and principles.

Context Of The Consultancy

The Humanitarian Logistics Cooperative, also known as “hulo”, is the first humanitarian European Cooperative Society (SCE) created in June 2021. Hulo now regroups 19 organisations: ACTED, Action contre la Faim (ACF), Bioport, Care International, Fleet Forum, the French Red Cross (FRC), Handicap International / Humanity & Inclusion (HI), International Federation of the Red Cross and Red Crescent (IFRC), Intersos, International Rescue Committee (IRC), Médecins du Monde (MDM), Mercy Corps, Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC), Oxfam Intermón, Plan International, Première Urgence International (PUI), Save the Children International, Solidarités International (SI), and Welthungerhilfe (WHH).

Its objective is to increase the impact of humanitarian aid by strengthening links and solidarity between humanitarian logistics actors and improving performance through the pooling of logistics and supply chain resources and expertise.

hulo is co-lead, alongside WFP and NRC, of the Global Humanitarian Procurement Collaboration and Performance Initiative, a 12-month action (1 September 2026 – 31 August 2027) funded by DG ECHO that operationalises the reform priorities identified by the Humanitarian Leadership Group on Supply Chain (HLGSC) and its Procurement Thematic Working Group (TWG). The action establishes a Global Procurement Forum, develops and tests targeted procurement cooperation guidance, strengthens procurement integration into organisational and project-level decision-making, and develops and pilots a board-level procurement KPI framework, engaging around 30 organisations and 60 practitioners across the humanitarian procurement ecosystem.

Overall Scope Of Work Expected From The Consultant

The Project Manager leads day-to-day implementation of the Global Humanitarian Procurement Collaboration and Performance Initiative, under hulo’s administrive contract, reporting to and managed by the Co-Leads Steering Committee, coordinating delivery of the action's four results – the Global Procurement Forum, targeted procurement cooperation guidance, procurement integration tools, and the board-level procurement KPI framework – across WFP, hulo, NRC, the Procurement TWG and around 30 participating organisations.

The Consultant Is Expected To

Establish overall project coordination and management
Maintain the consolidated implementation calendar, deliverable register, risk register and budget tracker across the four results.
Coordinate and report to the WFP-hulo-NRC Steering Committee and monthly management reviews, and support timely escalation of material changes to WFP for donor communication.
Ensure proper consultation, and inclusion of the participating organisation

Expected Deliverable:
Operational calendar, deliverable and risk registers, and a functioning Steering Committee coordination framework.

Drive delivery of the Global Procurement Forum
Coordinate consolidation of the procurement coordination landscape and gap analysis, and development of the Forum's governance and operating package (mandate, membership, decision-making, accountability, links to existing structures).
Coordinate targeted consultation and validation through the Procurement TWG, and preparation of the package for the relevant HLGSC leadership process and its subsequent operationalisation.

Expected Deliverable:
Validated Forum governance and operating package, and a leadership-ready briefing.

Coordinate procurement cooperation guidance, integration tools and the KPI framework
Manage and coordinate the Procurement Expert(s), Data Specialist, Academic Expert and other contributors in consolidating evidence, developing guidance, tools and KPIs, and steering technical review through the Procurement TWG.
Coordinate the selection and onboarding of pilot organisations to conduct activities, and consolidate pilot learning into refined, final outputs.

Expected Deliverable:
Validated procurement cooperation guidance, procurement-integration tool package, and board-level KPI package, each supported by documented pilot and testing evidence.

Manage stakeholder engagement, cross-TWG and donor coordination
Act as the senior coordination focal point with the Procurement TWG, other HLGSC working groups (Digitalization, Environmental Sustainability, Preparedness/Localization) and the HLGSC Donor Group.
Coordinate community-management, communication and visibility activities in line with ECHO requirements, including institutional announcements, knowledge products and social-media content.

Expected Deliverable:
Documented cross-TWG touchpoints and Donor Group engagement records, and a completed visibility and communication plan.

Consolidate monitoring, reporting and the implementation roadmap
Consolidate technical inputs for WFP's quarterly consolidated results and budget reviews and for DG ECHO reporting requirements.
Lead development of the final implementation roadmap, consolidating outputs, pilot learning, unresolved technical matters and future priorities, including inputs to the wider Supply Chain Charter process.

Expected Deliverable:
Consolidated monitoring inputs and a final implementation roadmap.

Qualifications And Experience

Interested Consultants should possess the following qualifications and experience:

Master’s degree in project management, supply chain/logistics, international development, business administration or a related field.
Significant experience (7+ years) in project or programme management, ideally leading multi-stakeholder or donor-funded (ECHO/UN) actions.
Strong knowledge of humanitarian supply chain and/or procurement systems, networks and coordination structures.
Proven experience coordinating consortia or co-led actions involving UN agencies, international NGOs and technical working groups.
Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, representation and consensus-building skills.
Strong budgeting, risk-management and results-monitoring skills; experience with donor reporting (ECHO Single Form) is a strong asset.
Organised, autonomous and able to manage delivery within a compressed 12-month timeline.
Languages: English and French (essential).

Management And Reporting Lines

The Project Manager works under the direct line management of hulo’s designated supervisor and is functionally accountable to the WFP-hulo-NRC Steering Committee for delivery of the action.

The Project Manager works under the direct line management and contractual authority of hulo’s designated supervisor, collaborates day to day with the WFP and other dedicated technical focal points on this project, and functionally accountability to the WFP–hulo–NRC Steering Committee for operational delivery.

The Project Manager is in charge of managing and structuring the work of the Procurement Expert(s), Data Specialist, Community Manager and Academic Expert, and of coordinating with the Procurement Thematic Working Group.

Schedule

This consultancy targets 100% time engagement over the 12-month action period (1 September 2026 – 31 August 2027).

Application & Contracting Process

The selected consultant will be contracted by hulo for the duration indicated above, on a full-time (100%) basis for the length of the action. He/She is expected to outline the main key steps of the process as part of the Expression of Interest (EOI). While the role is based full-time on the action, tasks can be carried out remotely where appropriate, with in-person participation expected for key hulo, TWG or Forum events.

Hulo invites applications for the provision of services described above. Interested candidates must submit their EOI outlining their financial offer (daily rate with clarifications on other cost covering expectations, plus a proposed overall cost), proposal to meet the ToR, scheduling and CV providing information on capacity and experience, showing qualification for the technical skills required by the scope of work.

Selection Criteria

Applications will be evaluated based on the following criteria:

Relevant experience and qualifications.
Quality and relevance of the technical proposal.
Financial offer.
Understanding of humanitarian and collaborative environments.

How to apply

Deadline & Application Information

Interested Consultants should express their interest as soon as possible, by sending an email containing all the above-mentioned documents to procurement@hulo.coop, mentioning HULO-HQ-PROC-2026-001 in the email title.

A shortlist will be established based on the offers received, and the consultation will follow the rules and procedures of hulo for the use of Consultants.

Please note: the interest shown by a Consultant does not imply any obligation on behalf of hulo for inclusion in the shortlist.

We are seeking a talented and motivated student intern for an Equity Research Analyst role. This is an extraordinary opportunity for a self-driven, analytically skilled student with an interest in financial markets, company valuation, and investment analysis.

As an Equity Research Analyst intern, you will work on cutting-edge AI-driven projects involving financial modelling, company valuation, sector analysis, and investment recommendations. Practical methodologies for equity research and financial analysis. Hands-on experience with financial modelling and valuation techniques. Student or fresh graduate from any academic discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Interest in financial markets and company analysis. Willingness to self-learn and work in a fast-paced environment.

Duration: Self-paced. Options of 15 days, 1 month, 2 months, 4 months, or 6 months.

jobs.description:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services.

About Parametric

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings. Learn more here: https://www.parametricportfolio.com/about

This role is part of Parametric’ s hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.

Excellent opportunity for recent or soon to be 2026 graduates! Office Locations: Seattle, Boston, Minneapolis, Alpharetta

WINTER COHORT STARTS - February, 2027

About The Operations Analyst Program

The Operations Analyst Program is an early-career development opportunity for driven recent and soon-to-be graduates who want to launch a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, data, and technology. Analysts use analytical, technical, and collaborative skills to help deliver operational excellence, solve business challenges, and improve outcomes for clients.

As investment operations evolve through data, automation, and AI, analysts gain hands-on experience supporting business-critical investment processes while helping identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Through ownership of operational processes and exposure to continuous improvement, data analytics, automation, workflow design, and AI, analysts strengthen controls, improve decision-making, and contribute to scalable solutions that support clients and business growth.

Over three weeks, Analysts begin as a cohort with an immersion in Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and Operations organization. Following onboarding, analysts join teams supporting Market, Client, or Control functions, where they develop domain expertise, learn business-critical workflows, and build an end-to-end understanding of how Operations supports clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.

Operations teams are responsible for the execution, oversight, servicing, and control activities that support the investment lifecycle. Analysts work closely with teammates and stakeholders across the organization to execute processes accurately, resolve operational challenges, improve controls, and deliver exceptional client outcomes.

In addition to their core team responsibilities, analysts may collaborate with specialized teams within Operations focused on process transformation, analytics, workflow modernization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Partnering with subject matter experts across Market, Client, and Control functions to identify opportunities, redesign processes, and implement scalable improvements that enhance operational effectiveness. Through this partnership, analysts may gain exposure to transformation initiatives while continuing to build deep operational expertise.

The program is designed for people who are curious about how businesses operate, motivated to improve processes, and eager to continue learning. As business needs evolve, analysts may gain exposure to different Operations functions, participate in cross-functional initiatives, or contribute to transformation efforts, broadening their knowledge, experience, and skill sets.

What You'll Do And Learn

Learn Parametric's investment strategies, operating model, and business-critical Operations workflows, and understand how Market, Client, and Control functions support clients, portfolios, risk management, and business growth.
Learn and execute business-critical investment operations workflows accurately and on time. Responsibilities may include activities such as cash and position reconciliation, trade lifecycle support, client servicing, corporate actions, account onboarding and maintenance, contracts, oversight activities, and billing, depending on team assignment.
Develop an end-to-end understanding of assigned processes, including activities, decisions, systems, data flows, controls, handoffs, and upstream and downstream dependencies.
Investigate exceptions, breaks, recurring operational issues, and client-impacting events using structured problem-solving and data analysis. Identify root causes, assess impacts, and recommend sustainable solutions.
Partner with Operations teams, portfolio managers, traders, sales, product management, technology teams, external providers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues, improve handoffs, and support business priorities.
Perform quality control and verification activities, maintain accurate records and documentation, and help ensure operational processes meet established policies, procedures, and control standards.
Analyze operational and investment data to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, bottlenecks, and emerging risks. Build reports, dashboards, or analytical tools that turn data into actionable insights and improvement opportunities.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or redesign workflows and contribute to process mapping, requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and adoption activities.
Collaborate with Automation, Reinvention & Collaboration (ARC) and other partners on process-improvement initiatives, workflow modernization efforts, analytics projects, automation solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Use or learn tools such as Excel, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, and approved AI solutions, as appropriate to the assignment.
Contribute to operational excellence, analytics, automation, or process-improvement initiatives and present findings, recommendations, and outcomes to team members and business partners.

What You'll Bring

Associate or bachelor's degree completed by the program start date. Relevant fields may include industrial, process, or systems engineering; operations research; supply chain; data science or analytics; computer science; information systems; mathematics; statistics; finance; accounting; economics; or a related analytical, business, or technical field. Candidates from other majors with relevant quantitative, technical, or process-improvement experience are also encouraged to apply.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous issues, work with data, identify root causes, and form well-supported conclusions.
A systems-thinking and continuous-improvement mindset, including curiosity about how people, processes, data, controls, and technology interact end to end and a desire to make work simpler, more accurate, efficient, scalable, and controlled.
High attention to detail and a commitment to quality, sound judgment, risk awareness, responsible use of data and technology, and positive client outcomes.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders and communicate complex ideas in a clear and organized manner.
Ownership, learning agility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.
Experience using spreadsheets to organize and analyze information and communicate findings, or the ability to learn quickly.
Strong interest in building a career at the intersection of investment management, operations, process improvement, data, and technology.
Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) by the program start date.

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, internships, or project experience involving process mapping, continuous improvement, business analysis, data analysis, automation, workflow design, programming, analytics, or AI.
Exposure to one or more tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python, workflow automation platforms, process-modeling tools, version control platforms, or similar technologies.
Familiarity with financial markets, investment management, or business operations. Prior investment operations experience is not required.
Experience contributing to a cross-functional project, presenting recommendations, developing a prototype, or helping others adopt a new process, workflow, or technology solution.

jobs.title: Business analyst
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Understand.
Build a 360° understanding of your product, users, business model, competitive landscape, and economics. Use AI, data, and research to uncover key business drivers, diagnose challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and product development.
Ideate.
Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.
Execute.
Turn the most promising opportunities into action and clear customer value. Support roadmap conversations with enterprise clients, build the business case, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to bring initiatives to life.
Optimize.
Use A/B tests, business and product metrics, and ongoing analysis to understand what works and what doesn’t. Scale successful initiatives, improve existing ones, and use each result to inform the next cycle of discovery and execution.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Understand.

Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.

Reasoning ability.

Team spirit.

You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our Lean Academy, Coursera® and online university.
